indication.text: ExEm Foam is an ultrasound contrast agent indicated for sonohysterosalpingography to assess fallopian tube patency in women with known or suspected infertility.

citations.quote: ExEm® Foam is indicated for sonohysterosalpingography to assess fallopian tube patency in women with known or suspected infertility.

target_moa.text: An ultrasound contrast agent: a foam created by mixing the kit components is instilled into the uterus and appears echogenic (white) inside the fallopian tube; when the tube is patent the foam travels through the tube and spills into the peritoneal cavity, enabling visualization of tubal patency.

citations.quote: ExEm Foam (air polymer-type A) intrauterine foam is an ultrasound contrast agent presented as a single-dose kit comprised of one 11-mL syringe containing 5 mL of clear gel [polymer-type A (hydroxyethyl cellulose), glycerin, and purified water], one 11-mL syringe containing 5 mL of sterile purified water, and a plastic coupling device that connects the two syringes.

On ultrasound, the foam appears echogenic (white) when inside the fallopian tube. When the tube is patent, the foam will be seen traveling from the uterine cavity, through the tube, and spilling into the peritoneal cavity.

modality.text: other (ultrasound contrast agent / intrauterine foam kit)

key_safety.text: Common adverse reactions are pelvic and abdominal pain; vasovagal reactions and associated symptoms such as nausea and faintness; and post-procedure spotting. There is a risk of post-procedure gynecological infections when used in sonohysterosalpingography.

citations.quote: The common adverse reactions associated with ExEm Foam when used as indicated in sonohysterosalpingography are: pelvic and abdominal pain; vasovagal reactions and associated symptoms such as nausea and faintness; and post-procedure spotting.
There is a risk of post-procedure gynecological infections when ExEm Foam is used in sonohysterosalpingography.
